elements.name: Daemon discovery and account choice
copy: No daemon is running on this computer

Sign in to Domovoi Cloud and connect from here instead.

elements.name: Repository selection and access
copy: Sessions run in a worktree, so your checkout is never modified.
The first is this computer's dialog. The second asks that machine's daemon.
A dirty checkout is fine: the worktree comes off the last commit.
Nothing here that the daemon may read. One level at a time, no recursive scan.
~/Documents is outside the roots you allowed on this machine. Reading it needs an approval, and your answer becomes a rule.
A directory that is not a repository is fine, the agent can git init it.
